text: **3. One real ordering gap in the WRITE chain.** The dependency graph is *partially* encoded — #2370 and #2372 both declare `Depends on: #2368`. But **#2371 ("delete anonymous explicit-route defaults") declares only `Blocks #2256`**, with no `Depends on` for #2370 (typed signer provenance) or #2369 (finalization gate). Deleting the anonymous route before the typed-provenance replacement is wired is exactly the build-then-delete inversion you avoided on the READ side. I'd add an explicit `Depends on: #2369, #2370` to #2371 so an agent doesn't pick it up first.
